scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @repassa/api" "npm run dev -w @repassa/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @repassa/api && npm run build -w @repassa/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @repassa/api && npm run test -w @repassa/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @repassa/api && npm run typecheck -w @repassa/web
